game_concept: A speed quiz set in Sand Dunes – Scarab Burrow, a scarab burrow: the caravan guide must handle desert bandits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Capstone Boss Chain: Beat a boss with phases that each demand a different skill from earlier weeks.
theme: Sand Dunes – Scarab Burrow: a scarab burrow
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Print every even number from 20 through 38. Trace the update by 2 and the final failed condition. Test dataset 5: {}; {}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Capstone Boss Chain' (Week 9 slot 15), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Scarab Burrow'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

source_player_objective: Collect 380 points of scarab charms by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
source_lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 380, or lives reach 0.
